title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-28

ai_review.summary: Terrible bootleg sound overwhelms an otherwise solid 1972 performance with a standout Jerry pedal‑steel on “Looks Like Rain.”
ai_review.review: The archive tape is plagued by an over‑driven, distorted bass that drowns out the rest of the band, making it virtually unlistenable for most listeners.  Despite the abysmal audio, several reviewers note that the actual show – as captured on the official Dick’s Picks 30 release – is a strong 1972 performance, highlighted by Jerry Garcia’s tasteful pedal‑steel work on “Looks Like Rain.”

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the recording very poorly (1‑star and 0‑star) due to audio problems, while a single reviewer praises the musical performance. The weighted average leans toward a low rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bass is over‑driven and dominates the mix; other instruments are low and often inaudible, resulting in a muddy, unlistenable bootleg.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No reviewer commented on set pacing; focus is almost entirely on the poor audio quality.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Pedal‑steel work on “Looks Like Rain” noted as sounding great.
